basis: Anti-C1-inhibitor autoimmunity causes defining subcutaneous and bowel-wall edema; less common upper-airway attacks omitted under the primary cap.

decisions.gastrointestinal: primary: bowel-wall angioedema is a defining visceral location of the disease itself; episodic reversibility does not exclude a primary disease site.

basis: Segmental anterior horn cell disease; muscle wasting results from denervation rather than direct disease of skeletal muscle.

decisions.musculoskeletal: none: defining hand muscle atrophy is secondary to motor-neuron loss and denervation; direct muscle injury is not established.

basis: Neurodegeneration and optic atrophy define disease. Amyotrophy in 4/4 reflects neurologic dysfunction; respiratory findings do not establish common direct lung injury.

decisions.musculoskeletal: none: amyotrophy in 4/4 establishes common wasting, but not direct muscle disease; denervation and profound neurologic disability explain it.

basis: ADAMTS13 deficiency causes hemolysis, thrombocytopenia and microvascular thrombosis. Stroke 25/120; direct renal injury at ≥30% is not established.

decisions.renal: none: renal dysfunction is variable, with no supplied frequency establishing ≥30%; it is not required for diagnosis of congenital TTP.

basis: Inherited iron metabolism disorder; hepatic fibrosis/cirrhosis in 2/2; cardiomyopathy affects roughly 30-50% of juvenile cases. Pigmentation alone does not establish skin injury.

decisions.hepatic: involved: iron deposition causes hepatic fibrosis/cirrhosis in 2/2; hepatic injury is an organ manifestation of the systemic iron metabolism disorder.

basis: Intestinal aganglionosis, cardiac defects and dysautonomia define disease; fixed joint contractures occur in 1/1 reported patient, with substantial frequency uncertainty.

decisions.musculoskeletal: involved: fixed finger/thumb contractures are structural joint impairment, reported in 1/1; accept the supplied frequency with limited confidence.

basis: Defining skeletal defects and cleft palate; CNS/cardiac malformations each 30-79%. Microtia 80-99% omitted at cap for severity; renal defects 5-29%; lung injury frequency unclear.

decisions.gastrointestinal: primary: severe cleft palate is part of the defining mandibulofacial malformation; the palate belongs to the mouth axis.
decisions.otologic: none under cap: microtia occurs in 80-99%, but defining skeletal/palatal defects and severe CNS/cardiac malformations take priority.

basis: Diabetic cataract is a lens disease; the underlying type 2 diabetes is a separately diagnosed metabolic disease.

decisions.metabolic_endocrine: none: hyperglycemia explains the cataract's cause, but the cataract does not itself damage an endocrine organ or constitute the underlying diabetes.

basis: Defining keratinization disease with inherited platelet-disorder parents; the definition establishes an enzymatic defect of sphingolipid metabolism.

decisions.metabolic_endocrine: primary: the definition establishes deficient sphingolipid synthesis from impaired enzyme function, supporting an inborn metabolic disorder beyond the gene name alone.

basis: Inflammatory disease of cerebral arteries is an organ-specific CNS vasculitis and cerebrovascular disorder.

decisions.neurologic: primary: cerebral arteritis is explicitly a CNS vasculitis and cerebrovascular disorder; neurologic location defines the disease rather than a subsequent complication.
